todos.requirement:
Build a standalone browser checklist. Use .new-todo input (Enter appends a trimmed nonempty title and clears input), .todo-list containing li items with label, and a .destroy button per item. Duplicate titles are distinct items; actions affect the chosen item. Start empty. No framework, server or external assets. Extra working features are allowed.
Double-click an item's label to edit it in a focused .edit input in that same li with class editing. Enter and blur commit trimmed input; empty committed input removes that item. Escape cancels without changing the saved title. While editing hide its normal controls. .destroy removes the selected item.

Build a standalone browser checklist. Use .new-todo input (Enter appends a trimmed nonempty title and clears input), .todo-list containing li items with label, and a .destroy button per item. Duplicate titles are distinct items; actions affect the chosen item. Start empty. No framework, server or external assets. Extra working features are allowed.
Each li has .toggle checkbox and completed class matching state. #toggle-all sets ALL stored items to its checked state, even when filtered; it is checked iff the nonempty collection is all complete. .todo-count strong always counts all active items. .clear-completed removes all complete items and is hidden when none exist. .filters links All, Active, Completed use #/, #/active, #/completed and selected class; update visible membership immediately when data or route changes. .main and .footer are hidden iff no items exist. A route survives page reload.

Build a standalone browser checklist. Use .new-todo input (Enter appends a trimmed nonempty title and clears input), .todo-list containing li items with label, and a .destroy button per item. Duplicate titles are distinct items; actions affect the chosen item. Start empty. No framework, server or external assets. Extra working features are allowed.
Each li also has a .toggle checkbox and completed class.
Persist saved item identity, title and completed state to localStorage key todos-transfer after every committed mutation. Restore on reload. Do not persist editing mode or unsaved edit text. Reload retains the current URL route. Use no network.

rows.requirement:
Build a standalone keyed table. A table contains tbody rows; each tr has data-id equal to the decimal row ID, td 1 displays that ID, td 2 contains an a with the label, td 3 contains an a.remove for removal when supported. A selected row has class danger. Start empty; IDs start at 1 and increase monotonically, including after clearing or replacing data. Labels are exactly Row N for ID N. Retain the same DOM tr object for every surviving data ID across updates, selection, removal, appends and reordering; removed/replaced IDs lose their nodes. No frameworks or network. Extra working controls are allowed.
Button #run replaces rows by 1000 fresh rows. #runlots replaces them by 10000 fresh rows. #add appends 1000 fresh rows. #clear removes all rows. Replacement and clearing clear selection. IDs never repeat during this page session.

Clicking the label link selects that row by ID. Clicking its a.remove removes that row only, retaining other row order and IDs; removing another row preserves selection. Removing the selected row clears selection. #swaprows exchanges the rows at zero-based indices 1 and 998 when at least 999 rows exist, otherwise does nothing. Selection follows data identity through swaps and removals.
